other.cycle_interval: 2 h for first 10 cycles, then 23 h

evidence.quote: Cyclic oxidation tests were carried out at both 800 °C and 900 °C in air. Oxidation tests were carried out in a muffle furnace (SX-10-13). The interval of the first 10 cycles was 2 h and the next cycles was 23 h; the total oxidation time was 503 h. Each cycle consisted of exposing the superalloys inside the furnace for the certain oxidation time and then 25 min air-cooling outside the furnace.
